description: Creates a model deployment under an endpoint. The deployment provisions asynchronously; monitor its status before routing live traffic to it.

schema.description: ID of the project that owns the endpoint.
ID of the endpoint that will contain the deployment.
When true, validates the request without creating or provisioning a deployment.

DE.CreateDeploymentRequest.description: Configuration for creating a deployment that binds a model and immutable config to an endpoint.

config.description: Immutable config revision in the form `projects/{projectId}/configs/{configRevisionId}`. The config must be compatible with the model.

configId.description: Deprecated. Use `config`. Config revision identifier to deploy, accepted when `config` is unset.

enableLora.description: Enables dynamic loading of LoRA adapters on the deployment.

model.description: Model resource name in the form `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}[/revisions/{revisionId}]`. Omit the revision segment to pin the latest revision at creation time.

modelId.description: Deprecated. Use `model`. Model identifier to serve, accepted when `model` is unset.

modelRevisionId.description: Deprecated. Use `model` with a /revisions/{revisionId} segment. If omitted, the latest revision is resolved at creation.

name.description: Name for the deployment within its endpoint. Returned as a fully-qualified endpoint string.

placement.description: Placement policy to use when scheduling the deployment.

DE.Deployment.description: Serving workload that binds a model and immutable config to an endpoint and manages its replicas.

autoscaling.description: Replica bounds, timing windows, and metrics that control horizontal scaling.

config.description: Immutable config revision in the form `projects/{projectId}/configs/{configRevisionId}`.

configId.description: Deprecated. Use `config`. Config revision identifier, populated during migration.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the deployment was created.

desiredReplicas.description: Number of replicas the autoscaler currently wants across all regions.

enableLora.description: Whether the deployment can dynamically load LoRA adapters.

endpointId.description: ID of the endpoint that contains the deployment.

estimatedEffectiveTrafficShare.description: Estimated fraction in [0, 1] of endpoint traffic that reaches this deployment under the current routing configuration. Absent or unrouted deployments are 0.

etag.description: Opaque version tag for optimistic concurrency control. Supply on update/delete to ensure consistent read-modify-write. If not set, the write overwrites based on current state.

hardware.description: Hardware selected by the deployment config, including GPU type and count.

model.description: Pinned model resource in the form `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}/revisions/{revisionId}`.

modelId.description: Deprecated. Use `model`. Model identifier being served, populated during migration.

modelRevisionId.description: Deprecated. Use `model` with a /revisions/{revisionId} segment. Pin to a specific model revision.

name.description: Project- and endpoint-qualified deployment name in the form `<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>/<deployment_name>`. Pass it as `model` in an inference request to target this deployment directly instead of using the endpoint's traffic split.

placement.description: Region constraints used to schedule the deployment's replicas.

projectId.description: ID of the project that owns the deployment.

runtimeInfo.description: Serving engine and feature support derived from the immutable config.

speculator.description: Pinned draft-model resource used for speculative decoding, in the same form as `model`. Omitted when speculative decoding is disabled.

speculatorId.description: Deprecated. Use `speculator`. Speculative decoding model identifier derived from the deployment config.

speculatorRevisionId.description: Deprecated. Use `speculator`. ID of the speculative decoding draft-model revision pinned at creation time.

status.description: Current lifecycle state and observed replica counts.

trafficMode.description: Whether the deployment serves client-visible responses or only mirrored shadow traffic.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the deployment was last updated.

maxReplicas.description: Maximum number of replicas. Defaults to `minReplicas`; omitting it on update preserves the current value.

minReplicas.description: Minimum number of replicas. Omit on update to preserve the current value. Set both `minReplicas` and `maxReplicas` to `0` to stop the deployment.

scaleDownWindow.description: Time a lower replica recommendation must remain stable before scaling down. Defaults to `5m`.

scaleToZeroWindow.description: Idle period after which the deployment automatically stops and releases its replicas.

scalingMetrics.description: Metrics and targets that drive replica recommendations. When omitted, the platform uses concurrent in-flight requests per replica.

DE.Placement.description: Placement controls where a deployment is scheduled.

inline.description: Inline placement parameters evaluated at deploy time.

profile.description: UID of a saved placement profile.

DE.AutoscalingResponse.description: Resolved autoscaling configuration returned for a deployment.

DE.RuntimeInfo.description: Runtime information derived from the deployment's configuration.

functionCallingSupported.description: Whether the runtime accepts tool and function-calling requests.

structuredOutputSupported.description: Whether the runtime can constrain generation to a structured output schema.

DE.DeploymentStatus.description: Current status of a deployment, derived at read time from internal state.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the current state.

readyReplicas.description: Total replicas actively serving traffic across all clusters.

scheduledReplicas.description: Replicas the scheduler has placed on clusters.

DE.ScalingMetric.description: Metric and target used by the autoscaler to recommend a replica count.

percentile.description: Percentile to evaluate for latency-based metrics: `p50`, `p90`, `p95`, or `p99`.

target.description: Target interpreted according to `type`. Utilization uses a percentage from 0 to 100, value uses an absolute measurement, and average value uses a per-replica measurement.

type.description: Whether `target` is an absolute value, a utilization percentage, or a per-replica average.

DE.InlinePlacement.description: Inline placement parameters expanded into scheduling rules by the server.

constraint.description: How strictly the regions list is enforced.

regions.description: Regions where the deployment is allowed to run. Multiple regions allow best-effort replica spreading.
